AXIS BANK LIMITED
Integrated Annual Report 2024-25 (Fiscal Year 2025)

MANAGEMENT
Amitabh Chaudhry serves as the Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer (MD & CEO) of Axis Bank.
Under his leadership, the Bank prioritised profitability over growth during fiscal 2025 while continuing
to invest in making the franchise more sustainable.

FISCAL 2025 CONSOLIDATED PERFORMANCE HIGHLIGHTS

Return on Assets (RoA):
Axis Bank delivered a consolidated Return on Assets (RoA) of 1.77% for fiscal year 2025.
Q4FY25 consolidated RoA was 1.88%.

Return on Equity (RoE):
Consolidated Return on Equity (RoE) for fiscal 2025 was 16.89%.
Q4FY25 consolidated RoE was 17.11%.

Asset Quality - Net NPA:
As on 31st March 2025, the Bank's consolidated Net NPA ratio was 0.33% of net customer assets.
Gross NPA as a percentage of gross customer assets was 1.28%.
Net NPA of 0.33% is among the lowest across large private sector peer banks.

Profitability:
FY25 Profit After Tax (PAT) was Rs 26,373 crores, up 6% year-on-year.
FY25 Operating profit was Rs 42,104 crores, up 13% year-on-year.
Q4FY25 PAT was Rs 7,117 crores, up 13% quarter-on-quarter.

Capital Adequacy:
Overall Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) stood at 17.07%.
CET-1 ratio was 14.67%, with net accretion of 93 basis points in FY25.

Balance Sheet:
Total assets size was Rs 16,099.30 billion.
Total deposits and CASA growth remained healthy through the year.

Business Segments:
Retail loans grew 7% year-on-year.
SME loans grew 14% year-on-year.
Corporate loans grew 8% year-on-year.
Small Business Banking, SME, and Mid-Corporate segments grew 14% year-on-year and now form
approximately 23% of the loan book.

Corporate loans grew 8% year-on-year.
Small Business Banking, SME, and Mid-Corporate segments grew 14% year-on-year and now form
approximately 23% of the loan book.

Digital and Payments:
Axis Bank maintains a strong position in UPI Payer PSP space with approximately 32% market share
by UPI volumes.
The Bank is amongst the largest players in Merchant Acquiring with terminal market share of ~19%.

Risk Management:
The Bank maintains best-in-class asset quality metrics with disciplined risk management,
prudent provisioning, and strong internal accretion to capital.

Outlook:
As the Bank enters FY26, management believes the operating environment is improving, which should
help drive both growth and profitability.
